description: Stations vélycéo électriques - informations is a dataset listed in Saint-Nazaire Agglo - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STRAN. Localisation des stations Vélycéo de vélo électriques en libre-service sur le territoire de Saint-Nazaire Agglo. Coverage: Saint-Nazaire Agglomération (Loire-Atlantique). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are station, vélo, libre-service. The portal shows 5 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-02-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-saintnazaireagglo-fr-portal.
